info.title: core-backend API
info.description: Endpoints of the core modules. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457). Requests with a session cookie that change state must send the X-CSRF-Token header.

get.summary: Public settings for the sign-in screens

post.summary: Create an account and sign in
post.description: The first account becomes the instance admin. After that, APP_SIGNUP=invite requires an invitation token.
Answers 401 with type /problems/mfa-required when the account has two-factor authentication and no code was sent. `code` takes a TOTP code or a recovery code.

post.summary: Confirm an email address with the emailed token

post.description: Always answers 202, so it does not reveal which addresses have accounts.

post.summary: Set a new password with the emailed token
post.description: Signs out every session of the account.

get.summary: The signed-in user and the CSRF token

post.description: Signs out the account's other sessions.

post.summary: Start setting up an authenticator app
post.description: Needs the current password, so a stolen session cannot enroll its own authenticator.

post.summary: Finish the setup with a code from the app

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave (members.manage to remove others)

post.summary: Which organization an invitation token is for
Join an organization with an invitation token
post.description: The invitation must be for the signed-in user's email address.

get.summary: API tokens: your own, or everyone's with tokens.manage

post.description: Permissions must be ones you have. The token can never do more than you can do now in this organization.
